name: Kawara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kawara town emblem in navy: an outlined ring with a cross at the top enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Kawara, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in August 1958.

features.role: Kawara town emblem — an outlined ring with a cross at the top enclosing a stylised mountain
